entities.name: Service Request Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to request establishment of bearers and signaling connection for services.

entities.name: EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED
entities.description: UE state when service request procedure has been initiated but not yet completed.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE
entities.description: UE state when EPS update status is set to EU2 NOT UPDATED and UE attempts to update.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: Normal registered state where UE can initiate and receive services.

entities.name: Timer T3417
entities.description: Timer used during service request procedure.

entities.name: Timer T3417ext
entities.description: Extended timer used during service request procedure for specific cases.

entities.name: Timer T3417ext-mt
entities.description: Extended timer used during service request procedure for mobile terminated cases.

entities.name: Timer T3325
entities.description: Timer started when service request attempt counter reaches 5, preventing further service requests.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Timer started with Extended wait time value, preventing service request initiation.

entities.name: Timer T3448
entities.description: Timer used for control plane data transfer in NB-S1 mode with Extended wait time CP data.

entities.name: Access Barred Condition
entities.description: Condition where network access is barred due to access class barring, EAB, ACDC, or network rejection.

entities.name: Lower Layer Failure
entities.description: Condition where NAS signaling connection fails or is released without Extended wait time.

entities.name: CS Fallback Cancellation Received
entities.description: Condition where UE receives cancellation request for CS fallback procedure.

entities.name: Abort Service Request Procedure
entities.description: UE behavior to abort the service request procedure and release allocated resources.

entities.name: Normal Cell Reselection
entities.description: UE behavior to stay in current serving cell and apply normal cell reselection process.

relations.description: Access barred condition leads to service request procedure abortion.
Lower layer failure causes UE to enter EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE state.
CS fallback cancellation received causes UE to enter EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE state.
Service request procedure starts timer T3417.
Service request abortion stops timer T3417.
Service request abortion stops timer T3417ext.
Service request abortion stops timer T3417ext-mt.
Service request procedure requires UE to be in EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED state.
Service request abortion causes UE to enter EMM-REGISTERED state.
Timer T3325 running prevents service request procedure initiation.
Timer T3346 running prevents service request procedure initiation.
Timer T3448 running prevents service request procedure for control plane data transfer.
Access barred condition leads to normal cell reselection behavior.
